testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-management.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23071 sales rep listing shows its columns and the OOB grid features work

scenario.summary: On the Sales Rep listing the admin checks the columns, sorts a column, filters, pages through more than one page and hides and shows a column.
steps: Open the Sales Rep listing; observe the columns.
Sort by Username ascending and descending.
Filter the listing by one sales rep's username (@rep1.userName).
With page size 10 and at least 11 sales reps, go to page 2 and back; change the page size.
Hide a column from the Columns menu and show it again.
stateChanges: The column visibility of the admin's listing is changed and restored by the test; the 11 sales reps are created and deleted by their collection.
assertions: The columns Username, Full Name, Email ID, Phone Number, Created Date and Action (Manage) are displayed
Sorting orders the rows by the column
Filtering by a username shows only that sales rep
Pagination moves between pages and the page size changes the number of rows shown
A hidden column disappears from the grid and comes back when shown again
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 8 (group A remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 8.3.
FSD 'Create a Sales Rep' and 'Manage an Existing Sales Rep': sorting, filtering, pagination and column customization stay OOB.
Pagination: the smallest page size is 10 and atstage has 2 sales reps, so 11 sales reps are created (rep1..rep11, user decision 2026-11-25, analysis 8.3).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
